Updated [src/lib.rs](/home/free/src/rust/smith-benchmark-2026-10-08/workspaces/baseline-01_backoff-codex-1/src/lib.rs) so delay uses bounded saturating arithmetic, preserves zero for a zero base, and deadline saturates on overflow. Added regression coverage for boundary values, huge attempts, and deadline overflow in [tests/regression.rs](/home/free/src/rust/smith-benchmark-2026-10-08/workspaces/baseline-01_backoff-codex-1/tests/regression.rs).

`CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/backoff-codex-target cargo test` passed all 4 tests. `git diff --check` passed.
